label: Minerals
text: EA.O.A1.1 Minerals. IMA definition: a mineral is an element or compound, normally crystalline, formed by geological processes (Nickel 1995). Its composition is definite but not necessarily fixed, allowing solid solution. Silicates dominate the crust. Identification is by habit, cleavage, hardness, optics, XRD and microprobe. Names follow IMA (W12).

warrant.defeaters: Solid solution misread as new species
